name: StreamController
tagline: Control your Elgato Stream Decks with plugin support
blurb: An elegant Linux app for the Elgato Stream Deck featuring advanced features like plugins and automatic page changing.
description:
An elegant Linux app for the Elgato Stream Deck featuring advanced features like plugins and
automatic page changing.

App Features:

• Elegant GTK4 Interface

• Plugin support with built-in store

• Multi-deck support

• Set background images & videos

• Set custom icons

• Automatic page switching (Gnome, Hyprland, Sway, KDE & X11)

• Multiple states per key

• Sticky actions available on all pages

• Auto-Lock your deck when your system is locked

• Command line & D-Bus API for scripting

Official Plugin Features:

• Execute commands

• Press hotkeys (X11 and Wayland)

• Move mouse (X11 and Wayland)

• Control OBS Studio

• Control your music

• Mix the volume of different apps

• Switch between audio outputs

• Mute your microphone

• Display the current time

• Send network requests

Supported devices

• Stream Deck Original

• Stream Deck Mini

• Stream Deck Mini Discord Edition

• Stream Deck XL

• Stream Deck Pedal

• Stream Deck Plus

• Stream Deck Plus XL

• Stream Deck Neo

• Stream Deck Studio

• Stream Deck Modules

Experimental support for devices from other manufacturers

• Mirabox Stream Dock 293S (no hotplug support yet)

• Ulanzi Stream Controller D200 (no hotplug support yet)

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
